messages:
alex.v: Quick check — we're adding an Interface VPC Endpoint for the partner webhook (svc.partner.internal). Need to confirm two things before I open the infra PR:
1) security group egress: partner asked for outbound to 52.48.120.0/24 on 443, is that OK?  
2) logs: will the webhook payloads or partner IPs end up in our centralized logs or S3 unredacted? I want to make sure we don't leak partner IPs to long-term analytics.

sasha: For (1) SG egress to a /24 is fine if it's a short-lived grant, but what's the lifetime? Can it be limited by tag or expiration? :hourglass_flowing_sand:  

maria: For (2) by default stdout -> fluentd -> logs bucket will include headers and source IPs. We should redact at the agent or fluentd filter. Suggest adding a filter to drop the X-Partner-Secret header and obfuscate source_ip.

jon: If we add a security group rule, remember interface endpoints still need SG ingress on port 443 from our app subnets. Egress from the app ENIs to the remote /24 is fine. Also confirm route table doesn't leak via NAT gateway.

lee_sec: Heads up: partner IP ranges must be approved by legal for storage even if redacted. If we redact at collection point (Fluentd), we can keep IPs out of S3 entirely — preferred. Otherwise we need a contract clause.

alex.v: OK — plan: add SG egress 52.48.120.0/24 tcp:443 with a 30d expiration tag, and land a fluentd config change to redact X-Partner-Secret and source_ip before shipping. Anyone object?

sasha: +1 on expiry tag. Can infra-bot create the multi-day rotation ticket? Also request that the PR includes the tagging automation snippet.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-9342 for SG rule with TTL tagging and INFRA-9343 for fluentd redact rule. Links: https://go/repo/INFRA-9342 https://go/repo/INFRA-9343 :robot_face:

maria: I'll prepare the fluentd filter. Quick patch:
```<filter kube.*>
  @type record_transformer
  <record>
    source_ip ${record["source_ip"] ? "REDACTED" : nil}
    headers ${record["headers"] ? record["headers"].except("X-Partner-Secret") : nil}
  </record>
</filter>
```
I'll put this behind a feature flag for the partner namespace.

jon: Permission question — who can merge the SG rule? I think network-admins and infra leads only. @lee_sec will you approve the security side?

lee_sec: I'll review the ticket. Approve conditional on: TTL tag present, fluentd patch staged in staging and logs confirmed redacted, and legal confirms partner IP policy. If all good, I'll sign off.

alex.v: Great — I'll open the infra PRs today, add the TTL tag, link the fluentd draft, and loop in legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
